paper_title: DeltaEdit Enhancing Sequential Editing in Large Language Models by   Controlling Superimposed Noise
caption: The variation curve of k^⊤β for AlphaEdit and MEMIT as the number of edits increases, with GPT2-XL serving as the edited model. As the results of Llama3-8B are not suitable for display in a line chart, they are presented in Appendix <ref>.
model_annotation: This line chart displays the variation of the metric k^⊤β for two editing methods, AlphaEdit and MEMIT, as the number of edits increases, with GPT2-XL serving as the base model; the x-axis represents the number of edits, ranging from 0 to 3000 in increments of 500, using a linear scale without explicit unit labeling, while the y-axis represents the value of k^⊤β, ranging from 0.002 to 0.012 in increments of 0.002, also using a linear scale; the AlphaEdit line is depicted in red with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 0.004 and decreasing to approximately 0.001; the MEMIT line is depicted in light blue with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 0.004 and increasing to approximately 0.0125.
